children: Dominion Energy announced an enhanced Virginia benefits package with four years of $10 monthly residential bill credits and expanded community investments tied to the NextEra combination.
Proposes doubling $10/month residential bill credits from two to four years, redirecting data-center credits to households.
Expands EnergyShare low-income assistance by $100 million through 2038; shareholders bear merger costs so customers pay nothing.
Commits to maintain Virginia headcount for five years, add 600 NextEra jobs and support ~400 supplier jobs, plus thousands indirect jobs.
Plans shareholder-funded NextEra co-headquarters tower in Richmond and $100 million workforce fund plus up to $1B annual Virginia Supplier Program.
Aims to accelerate solar, storage, dispatchable resources and nuclear development to improve affordability and reduce imported power.

title: NextEra-Dominion package boosts Virginia jobs, doubles $10 bill credits to 4 years
